titulo: He Ate and Slept on a Scale for 30 Years… Weight Vanished
titulos_alternativos: A Doctor Worked on a Giant Scale for 30 Years… and Found a Gap
He Weighed Every Meal for 30 Years to Chase Missing Weight
descripcion:
Around 1600, in Padua, a physician had a chair built that hung from a giant balance. They say he ate, worked and slept on it for about thirty years, weighing everything. Then his numbers refused to add up.
Source: Santorio Santorio, De Statica Medicina (1614); Encyclopaedia Britannica.
Absurd obsession or visionary science? Tell me in the comments.
